ops.title: Phase 4 — injection payload swap plus the pre-action gate
ops.description:
**Three of the four tiers already ship** — the plumbing, the event wiring and the `additionalContext` channel all exist; what they carry is `relevant`'s substring-and-anchor scoring. This phase replaces the payload and keeps the wiring, plus one net-new tier.

Ordering is already right and must stay: the block lands immediately after the system prompt or immediately before the final user turn, **never mid-history** (Liu et al. arXiv:2307.03172 — a relevant doc buried mid-context drops GPT-3.5 below its own closed-book baseline).

- Session start, ≤1,500 tok — `session.py:24` floats open tasks today. Becomes core memory: claimed tasks, open investigations on this branch, docs whose `when` trigger matches, top-N PPR seeded on branch + recent commits.
- Per-path, ≤500 tok — `surface.py:85` shells `cc-notes relevant <path>` **PostToolUse after Read**; `:112` drift-checks after Edit/Write. **Keep PostToolUse** — it is the existing convention and it needs the tool result to know the real path. Payload becomes the graph-ranked anchor-scoped slice, verdict-gated.
- Compaction — `compact.py:295` records touched entities, `:365` re-injects at the post-compact SessionStart. Re-inject core memory rather than a touched-entity list.
- Pull (MCP) — one consolidated tool, not raw graph primitives (few high-leverage tools; zero tokens when unused). Add MemGPT's A/R-stats line so the agent knows how much unretrieved material exists.
- **Pre-action gate — the one net-new tier.** Before editing a path carrying an open investigation, a known-failed prior attempt, or a stale-flagged fact, emit one warning line. `PreToolUse` on Edit/Write, pattern-match only, no ranking and no LLM. Highest value-per-line in the design (PROJECTMEM arXiv:2606.12329, "Memory-as-Governance").

Channel: `additionalContext` inside `hookSpecificOutput`, produced by returning `HookResult(action=Action.warn, message=…)` (`captain_hook/dispatch.py:124-131`).

Caps are hard limits, not defaults — every added token costs more than producing it, and context rot is measurable at 50K inside a 1M window.

ops.text: Caps enforced under fuzzed input at every tier
A live session shows the session-start block naming the real active work
PreCompact survives a real compaction and re-injects core memory
The pre-action gate fires exactly once on a path carrying an open investigation
A stale-flagged fact never appears at any tier
